cards.card_text: Then he fills that garden with an orchard of pomegranates and the finest spices, from henna and nard to cinnamon, myrrh and aloes.
cards.verse_text: Your branches are an orchard of pomegranates with the choicest of fruits, with henna and nard, with nard and saffron, with calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of frankincense tree, with myrrh and aloes, with all the finest spices.

cards.card_text: Then a woman comes in with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard.
cards.verse_text: While Jesus was in Bethany reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard.
cards.snippet: …woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard.

cards.card_text: Then Mary, Lazarus's other sister (John 11:1-2), brings out about a pint of expensive perfume made of pure nard.
cards.verse_text: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume, made of pure nard, and she anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped them with her hair.
